This page is under construction.

The ND-HNC provides hardware and infrastructure to support research activities. Please see below for detailed instructions on how to use these resources:

| Resource | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| HNC CorpFS | Centralize experiment protocols and participant response data. |
| [MRI Simulator](operate/mock.qmd){target="_blank"} | Prepare participants to contribute MRI data. |
| NordicNeuroLab | Deploy functional MRI paradigms and capture participant responses. |
| Stimulus Control Computer | Deploy lab-specific MRI paradigms. |
| DICOM Management Computer | Capture, organize, and send DICOM files to an appropriate location. |
